changeSet.author: codex
changeSet.comment: Keep the dev performer usable with the approved low-risk MVP catalog.
changeSet.sql:
UPDATE performer_category SET is_primary = false, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE performer_profile_id = ( SELECT id FROM performer_profile WHERE public_id = '06DEVPERFORMERPROFILE00001' );
INSERT INTO performer_category ( performer_profile_id, category_id, experience_years, price_from, price_to, currency, is_primary, created_at, updated_at ) SELECT performer_profile.id, category.id, 5, 5000.00, 25000.00, 'KZT', true, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM performer_profile JOIN category ON category.public_id = '06F5Z8NMT2F6FDSRCEXZMHNEMR' WHERE performer_profile.public_id = '06DEVPERFORMERPROFILE00001' ON CONFLICT (performer_profile_id, category_id) DO UPDATE SET experience_years = EXCLUDED.experience_years, price_from = EXCLUDED.price_from, price_to = EXCLUDED.price_to, currency = EXCLUDED.currency, is_primary = true, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP;
